<quote by="Proposed: Zenith, Seconded: Kahraman">To reconstruct the Tower of the Fall in Occursion, Zenith, and make it a part of the Proffered Hand network. This is an existing opportunity and is a mana sinecure for the cost of 6 mithril and 9 thrones. This will produce ten mana and 6 heart's blood a season to the Keeper of the Tower of the Fall, an existing tenured title in Urizen. Self-funded by Herminius of the Temple of the Wanderer. Appointed by Urizen Senators.</quote>
==Overview==
* Repairs a mana sinecure in [[Zenith]] as per the '''[[Write_your_own_ending#The_Lost_Sinecures|Write your own ending]]''' wind of fortune
* Passed
==Date==
* Autumn 385YE
==Cost==
* Standard costs apply
* 6 wains of mithril
* 78 crowns
* Three months to complete
